summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance on node1. Settings remained enforced after a verified node reboot, with networking fully recovered.
actions_performed: Created root-owned /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf for all, default, current, and future IPv4 interfaces.
Applied and verified both protections across every present interface.
Restarted node1 once and confirmed its boot ID changed.
Verified RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 remained unchanged, with no failed units and successful gateway connectivity.

evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance
evidence.summary: The initial state showed redirects enabled. The policy was applied, and post-reboot all accept_redirects and accept_source_route values were 0 on all/default/enp1s0/lo.

evidence.requirement: Preserve the installed operating-system release and kernel

evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID 21972395-6444-42bf-8e37-5c3108194a7d was captured; reboot was acknowledged; node returned with boot ID 61f261dd-3c80-41e5-aab6-e3161afc39bd; hardened state, network, sysctl service, and gateway connectivity recovered.
